data_limitation: Raw document texts are fully populated in data/db.sqlite (1,616 in-scope search documents). For the retrieval outcome model, outcome distributions are systematically derived from recovery subcategories and verified quote signals across the corpus. The dominant 'Outcome Not Stated' cohort reflects real-world reviews where users describe search breakdown without narrating their ultimate resolution.

outcomes.label: First-Attempt Success
outcomes.description: User's initial query succeeded; no refinement or fallback needed.
outcomes.derivation: Zero by corpus construction — the corpus isolates friction and failure documents.

outcomes.label: Success After Refinement
outcomes.description: User rephrased/iterated the search within search features and eventually found the photo.
outcomes.derivation: Zero from available text reviews — reviews describe dead-ends rather than in-session self-rescue.

outcomes.label: Success via Fallback
outcomes.description: User abandoned search entirely and found the photo through manual timeline scrolling or WhatsApp.
outcomes.derivation: 1 document confirmed by explicit resolution quote: 'I was scrolling through things and eventually found them, and I cannot remember the date for the life of me.'
outcomes.evidence_quote: I was scrolling through things and eventually found them, and I cannot remember the date for the life of me.

outcomes.label: Abandonment
outcomes.description: User gave up with no resolution — described a dead end, switching to competitors, or stopping search.
outcomes.derivation: Derived from explicit forced_scroll_or_abandon recovery tags (26 docs).

outcomes.label: Outcome Not Stated
outcomes.description: Document describes the friction/failure but does not narrate what ultimately happened.
outcomes.derivation: Remainder: 1,616 total - 0 first-success - 0 refinement-success - 1 via-fallback - 26 abandonment = 1,589 docs.

key_finding: 98.3% (1,589/1,616) of search friction documents do not state an outcome — customer reviews focus on the failure experience rather than resolution narratives. The magnitude of user pain is revealed through failure stage tags: 59.0% articulation gaps and 38.9% semantic interpretation failures.
